clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau breaks down two things to check on a supplement label before you buy.

First: dyes. He says if a product lists any dye, red, blue or otherwise, put it back on the shelf and don't buy from that company again.

Second: fillers, also called excipients, like steric acid and magnesium stearate, added to help manufacturing and shelf life. Kevin's challenge: take a spoonful on its own and see how your body reacts.

His verdict, plainly: it's toxic.
